title: What is the average lap time for Lewis Hamilton in the 2009 Malaysian Grand
question:
What is the average lap time for Lewis Hamilton in the 2009 Malaysian Grand Prix?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: average lap time = AVG(milliseconds); 'Lewis Hamilton' refers to the full name of the driver; Full name of the driver refers to drivers.forename and drivers.surname; 'Malaysian Grand Prix' refers to races.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix'

prediction.sql: SELECT AVG(lt.XCL_048) AS average_lap_time FROM lapTimes AS "lt" JOIN drivers AS "d" ON "lt".XCL_044 = "d".XCL_034 JOIN races AS "r" ON "lt".XCL_043 = "r".XCL_065 WHERE d.XCL_038 = 'Lewis' AND d.XCL_039 = 'Hamilton' AND r.XCL_069 = 'Malaysian Grand Prix' AND r.XCL_066 = 2009

arguments.sql:
SELECT AVG(lt.XCL_048) AS average_lap_time
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON lt.XCL_044 = d.XCL_034
JOIN races r ON lt.XCL_043 = r.XCL_065
WHERE d.XCL_038 = 'Lewis'
  AND d.XCL_039 = 'Hamilton'
  AND r.XCL_069 = 'Malaysian Grand Prix'
  AND r.XCL_066 = 2009;
